$comment: Ansys Icepak response for a stress-test BoD: same platform (VR NVL72 Max P)
but coolant inlet raised to 40C and rack power pushed to 165 kW. Icepak
reports the top row of racks breaching the NVIDIA envelope. The adapter
surfaces hotspot_violation=true and the optimizer disqualifies the
candidate before it can win the sweep.

warnings: Rack R02D outlet coolant 46.8 C exceeds NVIDIA VR NVL72 Max P envelope (45.0 C)
Consider: reduce inlet temp, add secondary loop capacity, or de-rate GPU power
